interpretation: No construction change is proposed. A hypothetical permit-crosswalk mapping (joining each limit row's LIMIT_FREQ_OF_ANALYSIS_CODE to the matching permit's Part I MEASUREMENT FREQUENCY for the same permit number and pollutant) would assign human-readable frequencies such as Five/Week, 1/Day, and 1/Week to calendar codes, but the frozen packet does not establish that mapping as workspace truth. A standalone codebook mapping (e.g. 05/WK = five times per week) lacks any workspace definition file.
exact_grounding: Packet contradictory_evidence and known_limitations: permit text never uses opaque tokens; PASS_TASK rules forbid treating structural CSV correlation alone as a code legend; no workspace file defines LIMIT_FREQ_OF_ANALYSIS_CODE semantics.
